    "scope": "Predeclared visible-action reference for transfer checking, not a hygiene-quality assessment. Unseen actions remain unknown. No expected timestamps are supplied.",
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "wet",
        "label": "Wet hands with water",
        "criterion": "Running or poured water visibly contacts hands before a visible soap-lather episode. A faucet or sink alone is insufficient."
      },
      {
        "id": "soap",
        "label": "Apply soap to hands",
        "criterion": "Hands visibly receive soap from a dispenser, bottle, or bar. Lather alone does not prove application."
      },
      {
        "id": "lather",
        "label": "Rub hands with soap lather",
        "criterion": "Hands rub together with visible soap foam; rubbing without visible foam is uncertain."
      },
      {
        "id": "rinse",
        "label": "Rinse hands with water",
        "criterion": "After visible lather rubbing, water visibly contacts the hands; rubbing beside a faucet is insufficient."
      },
      {
        "id": "dry",
        "label": "Dry hands",
        "criterion": "A towel or paper visibly contacts and wipes the hands, or hands are held in a visibly operating air dryer. Holding a towel nearby is insufficient."
      }
    ]
  },

        24.0

      "index": 4,

    },
    {
      "step_id": "dry",
      "status": "unknown",

The 26.5, 27 and 31.936 s views show the running faucet and empty basin, with no hands wiping on paper/towel or contacting a visible operating dryer. These supplied views do not support drying.",
